title: Internship Retail Design (Feb/March 2027)
note: Retail and campaign display design internship in English; only for product or industrial design students whose program includes a 5–9 month compulsory internship, and a portfolio is required.

facts.duties: Design and model 3D campaign props and renderings, support prototyping, prepare production drawings in SolidWorks or Rhino, and help with brand campaign concepts and presentations.
facts.requirements: Enrolled product/industrial design student with a 5–9 month mandatory internship; Rhino plus a rendering tool; fluent English.
facts.apply: Apply online via JOIN with portfolio.
